full_prompt_en: The image is a square comic-style digital illustration of a silver-haired man working with a small mechanical device, surrounded by bright pink electrical light against a dusty purple background. Behind his head, irregular angular structures and small dark fragments create a shallow, densely drawn setting. Pink-white arcs loop across this background, their fine branching lines glowing against subdued mauve and plum. Some curves reach the top and side edges, making the luminous pattern feel larger than the cropped scene. The man leans forward from the centre, with his head tilted downward and slightly toward the right side of the frame. His eyes look intently outward beneath deeply drawn brows, and his closed mouth reinforces the tense expression. Short silver-grey hair rises in thick, swept-back waves, described with narrow dark lines and pale highlights. Strong creases cross the forehead and frame the nose and mouth. His face is clean-shaven, with warm peach planes interrupted by angular grey-brown shadows. A pale cream jacket covers a dark, muted violet collared shirt. The broad lapels turn outward on either side of the chest, and clusters of thin creases describe the sleeves as his arms bend forward. Pale pink reflections break across the cream fabric, while cooler grey-violet shading gives the folds depth. Across the lower-left portion, one hand grips the dark handle of a slender device, with the thumb near a small cool-coloured detail. The device runs diagonally inward toward a busier cluster of small metal shapes and luminous pink marks near the chest. A circular greenish component, concentric lines and tiny warm accents make this central mechanism distinct from the larger clothing shapes. On the lower-right side, his other hand reaches around the apparatus, with bent fingers outlined against the pale sleeve and electrical glow. The two hands and the device form a compact area of action below the face. Curving dark cables and brilliant pink energy trails cross in front of the jacket and thread through the mechanism, with fine sparks gathering around their intersections. The lower edge cuts off the torso and parts of the arms, leaving the viewer close to the action. Dark ink-like contours define the face, hands and machinery, while the colouring remains broken and textured rather than smoothly photographic. Warm illumination models the exposed skin; the electrical effects add sharply concentrated pink-white brightness against the softer purple shadows. The overall composition links the concentrated expression to the busy diagonal hand movements, balancing cream clothing and warm skin with tangled pink light and a subdued violet setting.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形漫画式数字插画：一名银发男子操作着小型机械器具，明亮粉色电光环绕四周，背景呈含灰的紫色。头部后方，不规则棱角结构与细小暗色碎形构成浅而密集的绘制空间。粉白电弧绕过背景，纤细分叉的线条在低饱和灰紫和深紫色前发亮。部分弧线延伸至上方与侧边，使发光图形仿佛超出画框。男子从中央向前倾身，头部下压并略朝画面右侧倾斜。他在深刻眉线下专注望向画外，闭合嘴唇加强紧张神情。短银灰发向后蓬起，以细暗线与浅色高光描绘发束。明显皱纹横过额头，并围住鼻口。脸上没有胡须，暖桃色面部被棱角分明的灰棕阴影切分。浅奶油色外套覆在低饱和深紫翻领衬衫外，宽翻领从胸前两侧向外折开。手臂向前弯曲，使袖子聚起成组的纤细褶线。浅粉反光落在奶油色布面上，较冷的灰紫阴影赋予衣褶深度。左下方，一只手握着细长器具的深色柄部，拇指靠近一处小型冷色细节。器具斜向画面内部，连到胸前细小金属形体与发亮粉色痕迹聚集的区域。一个泛绿的圆形部件、同心线与微小暖色点使中央机械部分区别于宽大的衣服色面。右下侧，另一只手伸向器具，弯曲手指在浅色袖子和电光前显出轮廓。双手与器具在脸部下方构成紧凑的动作区域。弯曲暗色缆线与明亮粉色光迹从外套前方交错而过，穿行于机械之间，交会处聚着细小火花。画面下缘裁去躯干和部分手臂，使观看距离贴近动作。深色墨线般的轮廓界定脸、手和机械，着色带有断续肌理，并非平滑摄影表面。暖光塑造裸露皮肤，电光则在较柔和的紫色阴影间形成高度集中的粉白亮点。整体构图把专注神情与下方交错的斜向手部动作相连，以奶油色衣着和暖肤色平衡缠绕粉光及含灰紫色背景。
style_prompt_en: The digital illustration combines softly modeled focal forms with crisp graphic contours and layered decorative marks. Saturated magenta, plum, violet and cyan sit against deep blue shadow, while pale cream accents and narrow luminous lines create separation. Curved bands and angular patches overlap without becoming a literal setting; small scratch-like strokes loosen the larger flat areas. Directional warm highlights meet cool blue-violet shade, giving forms depth while preserving a vivid, designed surface. The composition gathers attention near the centre, then uses diagonals and arcs to carry the eye outward. The overall treatment feels cinematic and energetic, balancing painterly volume with graphic pattern.
style_prompt_zh: 数码插画将柔和塑造的焦点形体与清晰图形轮廓、多层装饰笔痕结合起来。鲜明洋红、李子紫、紫罗兰与青色映衬深蓝阴影，奶油白点缀和细亮线形成分隔。弧带与棱角色块彼此叠合，却不构成具体场景；短促刮痕则松动较大的平涂色面。暖色定向亮部与冷蓝紫阴影交汇，塑造体积，同时保留鲜明设计感表面。构图将注意力聚集于中央，再以斜线和弧线把视线向外引导。整体效果富有电影感与动势，在绘画体积和图形纹样之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A silver-haired man handling a device amid looping pink electrical light
theme_zh: 粉色电光环绕中操作器具的银发男子
name: Doctor Who
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
